pythonFunction.name: validate_cc_last4
pythonFunction.description:
Checks the last 4 digits of the card on file against the account (only when get_auth_options
returned cc_on_file true). The digits are never repeated back or logged. Before calling this
tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    cc_last4: The four digits, spoken, keyed or typed (REQUIRED).
    gateway: Payment gateway label of the tenant (Kubra for Washington Gas, Invoice Cloud for
        SEMCO); informational.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, result (Pass or Fail), attempts_remaining and agent_action; on Pass
    auth_status becomes Authenticated.
